notes: Creator Idle, Walk, Run animation exports merged. Duplicate Maya short joint names normalized to full hierarchy paths before animation-track binding.
Largest four FBX skin weights kept and normalized by Three loader. 78 source rig bones, 58 runtime weighted joints; unweighted transforms retained as glTF nodes.
Original 2048px albedo and tangent normal converted to JPEG; Unity smoothness alpha inverted/clamped to roughness and packed into glTF green channel; non-metal skin. Source geometry and UV unchanged.
conversion.runtime_usage: Two skeleton clones play authored Idle/Walk clips, follow continuous collision-aware paths, and turn heads toward visitor. Run exported for provenance but not used for lunges.
conversion.quality_boundary: Authored textured game model; not photogrammetry or a claim of photorealism. No copied television character.

runtime_collision.foot_support: Sample authored sole vertices after updating SkinnedMesh bind matrices; shift independent model wrapper vertically to terrain contact without editing geometry.
